Kerala Minister Warns of Strict Action Against Drug Mafia and Pharmacies

Kerala Home Minister K. Muraleedharan, also referred to as Chennithala in one report, has announced strict action against drug mafia and pharmacies. The minister warned that those involved in attacking police personnel would face severe consequences. Additionally, pharmacies were cautioned against dispensing medicines without prescriptions.
